referees.quote: I support its publication in nature communications after the authors address my question.
However, I have a few comments and questions that must be addressed before evaluating the claims in their entirety.

note: No transfer from another journal is indicated; the first round is Version 0. Neither referee uses the scale words. R1 raised one clarification question about Fig. 4 and Eq. 2 and otherwise supported publication, so this reads as minor revision. R2 withheld judgment on the claims pending answers to about nine points. These include the reliability and variance of the control-resonator comparison (the authors answered with new measurements and simulations), contact and filter effects, DC critical-current cross-checks, error-bar estimation and missing key references. That reads as major revision, though it could be read as minor. No referee co-signed another's report.
